scope: Independent read-only source review of mutable cache microbenchmark; no build, test, or workload executed.
conclusion: No correctness blocker in frozen C and runner. Suggested runner assertions and scope documentation are included; root owns build/smoke/performance validation.
ownership_findings: Each successful operation gets one MEMTABLE read handle, claims it, upgrades to write (which marks dirty), validates and increments counter/complement, then unlocks, unclaims and ungets before accounting success.

Every failed claim ungets before retrying same logical address. Stop checks on this path occur without a read reference, so the claimant can drain readers. Failure and successful completion paths release acquired ownership before exit.

Immutable page identity is checked under read ownership; mutable counter/complement is read and written only after write lock, avoiding races between competing writers. The post-join verification has no active writers.

Unsigned counter overflow is rejected at UINT64_MAX. All successful updates including warmup and terminating batches are recorded in worker all_ops. Post-join exact counter totals match worker totals, with per-owner totals additionally checked for disjoint mode.
geometry_findings: One scenario per process and zero-initialized counter / UINT64_MAX inverse prevent cross-scenario accounting contamination.
For pages>=threads, worker i selects k*threads+i with 0<=k<floor((pages-1-i)/threads)+1; domains are nonempty, disjoint, within pages and cover every index, including partial final partitions.

Working-page override permits 32 through 75% cache capacity. Partial last extents are zero-filled and only requested page identities initialized; only requested pages are preloaded/accessed/verified. Extents remain allocated until workers and verification complete.
timing_findings: Workers register deterministically, pin to configured CPUs and share one frozen executable across libraries. CPU counters cover successful operations and retry/wait work during each worker measurement phase.

Final process CPU/I/O snapshot occurs after worker joins but before worker logging, counter verification and dirty-page count. Explicit flush/wait/evict occurs later; timed I/O and major faults must be zero.

Two-second warmup normally dirties the resident working set; the measured path mostly exercises repeated writes to already-dirty pages, not allocation, clean-to-dirty transitions, writeback, or eviction pressure.
Claim failures count explicit try_claim failures only. Blocking cache_get retries/waits contribute time/CPU but have no separate count. Successful writes, not attempts, define throughput.

Phase observation occurs once per 64-operation batch; warmup_ops is all_ops minus measured ops and includes any prefix after controller measurement begins but before the worker observes phase 2. Stop drain is included up to last worker finished timestamp.
Shared and disjoint modes alter per-worker working set and ownership overlap. Compare source profiles within each mode; cross-mode differences cannot be attributed solely to contention.
runner_findings: Default matrix uses main/original/async-mask, one/eight workers, disjoint/shared, 32 pages, and three rotating mirrored blocks with excluded scenario preconditions.

Outer machine lock serializes all runs; job.run uses lock_held=True and finite duration+warmup+300 second process timeout. Effective environment explicitly sets layout, disk ratio, working pages, CPU and warmup/perf controls.

Runner checks successful process exit, exact mode/API/threads/warmup/pages, errors/I/O/faults, source-selected library hash, deterministic worker IDs, all-update and claim-failure sums, positive dirty pages, and zero disjoint claim failures.
validation_recommendation: Before final measured matrix, bounded one/eight-worker disjoint/shared smokes should check exact update sums, zero timed I/O, meaningful shared failures and no disjoint failures. A nonmultiple working set (33 pages) smoke exercises partial partition and extent construction. Do not use smoke throughput as evidence.
limitations: Source review does not establish performance or explain database insertion losses. This probe excludes tree navigation, memtable splits, allocation, compaction, logging, cache capacity pressure and I/O.
final_touchups_verified: Runner validates sum(worker.ops)==CSV ops and exact cache_mib.
README documents already-dirty scope, phase-boundary warmup accounting, limited claim-failure counter and cross-mode interpretation.
